thread:
Aisha: tiny layout thing from the usability lab: when users finish the first-run checklist the CTA "Mark complete" sits flush with the bottom nav and gets clipped on small viewports. We should add a sm-padding-bottom to the checklist container.
Dylan: noted. what's the smallest viewport you saw this on?
Aisha: iPhone SE (portrait) and Android small devices. 320px width and the bottom nav is 48px high.
Sam: can we make the CTA sticky above the nav using safe-area-inset-bottom and position: sticky? That keeps it visible.
Kevin: sticky is fine but remember Safari behavior on iOS sometimes treats position: fixed differently with the on-screen keyboard. Use env(safe-area-inset-bottom) and add 56px min-offset.
Elaine: accessibility note: if CTA is sticky, ensure it's reachable in DOM order and doesn't trap keyboard focus. Use aria-hidden on decorative overlays.
Dylan: probably simpler: add padding-bottom: calc(env(safe-area-inset-bottom) + 56px) to checklist container and keep CTA in-flow. avoids sticky quirks.
Aisha: that works. also, copy tweak: change "Mark complete" to "Finish setup" — testers thought it sounded friendlier. Keep 2-word CTA.
Sam: agree. We'll also shorten helper text under CTA to one line: "You can revisit the checklist anytime from the Help menu."
Kevin: implement note: add a feature flag 'onboard:ui-fix/bottom-padding' so we can roll out to 10% first. Add unit test around computed padding for small viewports.
Elaine: also ensure the CTA has 44px min touch target and contrast ratio 4.5:1.
Aisha: last user feedback: keyboard users expected Enter to submit the checklist when focused on the CTA; ensure native button element is used and not a div with role=button.
Dylan: yep. use <button> with type="button" and onclick. we'll audit similar surfaces.
onboard-bot: FYI  task #4620 created: bottom-padding fix for checklist.
Dylan: I'll update the spec and post a diff in the repo.
Sam: prototyping now, will include mobile safe-area padding.
Kevin: I'll add the feature flag and tests.
Elaine: I'll add a quick checklist test to our a11y suite for mobile viewport and keyboard.
Aisha: thanks folks. small wins for onboarding UX! :sparkles:
